neighbours.label: names of a measured physical quantity or variable (intensity, concentration, weight, height, age)
fire: In the lab we recorded how the signal intensity changed over each trial.
Nurses checked the patient's weight every morning before breakfast.
The plasma concentration of the drug peaked after two hours.
Researchers noted that average height rose steadily over the century.
The graph plots daily temperatures against hours of sunlight.
Climbers felt the thin air once their altitude passed four thousand meters.
The sensor reports the humidity level to the controller every minute.
Engineers measured the pressure inside the tank after each fill.
quiet: In the lab we recorded how the students changed over each trial.
Nurses checked the patient's chart every morning before breakfast.
The plasma sample of the drug arrived after two hours.
Researchers noted that average families rose steadily over the century.
The graph plots daily visitors against hours of opening.
Climbers felt the thin air once their group passed the old hut.
The sensor reports the error message to the controller every minute.
Engineers inspected the valve inside the tank after each fill.
